name: Goon
ability: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
designRole: The first ability chooser targeting the Goon becomes drunk, and the Goon changes alignment to theirs.
explanation: The first ability chooser targeting the Goon becomes drunk, and the Goon changes alignment to theirs.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon has the Goon ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
